papers.title: UniVidX: A Unified Multimodal Framework for Versatile Video Generation via Diffusion Priors
papers.abstract: Recent progress has shown that video diffusion models (VDMs) can be repurposed for diverse multimodal graphics tasks. However, existing methods often train separate models for each problem setting, which fixes the input-output mapping and limits the modeling of correlations across modalities. We present UniVidX

papers.title: Web2BigTable: A Bi-Level Multi-Agent LLM System for Internet-Scale Information Search and Extraction
papers.abstract: Agentic web search increasingly faces two distinct demands: deep reasoning over a single target, and structured aggregation across many entities and heterogeneous sources. Current systems struggle on both fronts. Web2BigTable adopts a bi-level architecture for web-to-table search supporting both regimes.

papers.title: Map2World: Segment Map Conditioned Text to 3D World Generation
papers.abstract: 3D world generation is essential for applications such as immersive content creation or autonomous driving simulation. We introduce Map2World, enabling 3D world generation conditioned on user-defined segment maps of arbitrary shapes and scales, ensuring global-scale consistency.

papers.title: Prox-E: Fine-Grained 3D Shape Editing via Primitive-Based Abstractions
papers.abstract: Text-based 2D image editing models have reached impressive maturity. We propose Prox-E, a training-free framework that enables fine-grained 3D control through explicit, primitive-based geometric abstraction, addressing limitations in fine-grained structural 3D editing.

papers.title: From Skill Text to Skill Structure: The Scheduling-Structural-Logical Representation for Agent Skills
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills. We introduce SSL representation (Scheduling-Structural-Logical) for agent skills, enabling machine-readable skill management beyond text-heavy SKILL.md-style artifacts.

papers.title: Learning while Deploying: Fleet-Scale Reinforcement Learning for Generalist Robot Policies
papers.abstract: We present Learning While Deploying (LWD), a fleet-scale offline-to-online reinforcement learning framework for continual post-training of generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies during deployment.

papers.title: Stable-GFlowNet: Toward Diverse and Robust LLM Red-Teaming via Contrastive Trajectory Balance
papers.abstract: We propose Stable-GFN (S-GFN), which eliminates partition function Z estimation in GFN and reduces training instability for LLM red-teaming, achieving diverse and robust attack generation.

papers.title: Trees to Flows and Back: Unifying Decision Trees and Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: This work unifies decision trees and diffusion models by establishing a mathematical correspondence between hierarchical decision trees and diffusion processes, revealing a shared optimization principle: Global Trajectory Score Matching.

papers.title: When Do Diffusion Models learn to Generate Multiple Objects?
papers.abstract: We study multi-object generation failures in text-to-image diffusion models, introducing mosaic (Multi-Object Spatial relations, AttrIbution, Counting) as a controlled framework for dataset generation and analysis.

papers.title: Odysseus: Scaling VLMs to 100+ Turn Decision-Making in Games via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: We study RL-based training of VLMs for long-horizon decision-making in Super Mario Land, requiring 100+ turns of interaction with coordinated perception, reasoning, and action.

cc_updates.body: The `/model` picker now lists models from your gateway's `/v1/models` endpoint when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at an Anthropic-compatible gateway. Added `claude project purge [path]` to delete all Claude Code state for a project. `--dangerously-skip-permissions` now bypasses prompts for writes to `.claude/`, `.git/`, `.vscode/`, shell config files. `claude auth login` now accepts OAuth code pasted into terminal. Auto mode spinner turns red when permission check stalls. Fixed image pasting larger than 2000px, OAuth login timeouts, and many other issues.
Fixed OAuth authentication failing with a 401 retry loop when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1` is set.

Added `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER` environment variable to select Bedrock service tier. Pasting PR URL into `/resume` search now finds the session that created it. `/mcp` shows claude.ai connectors hidden by manual servers. OpenTelemetry improvements. Fixed `/branch` producing forks with tool_use errors, `/model` Effort option for Bedrock ARNs, Vertex AI structured-output errors, and many other fixes.
